transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I came in because... well, I just keep thinking it would be better if I didn't wake up in the morning. Honestly, sometimes I feel like dying would just be the fair punishment for what I've done to my family, and to my crew at work.
Have you ever had a distinct period when you felt unusually elevated or irritable compared with your usual self?

No, I don't think so. I've never really felt elevated or... like I had a lot of energy. It's mostly just been this heavy feeling, like I can't do anything right. I haven't noticed any times where I felt unusually good or irritable, just... down.
What was happening in your life when these feelings first began?

Well, this has been going on for about a year and five months now. It all started around the time my husband had a bad back injury. He's been mostly housebound since then, and... that's when things just started getting really heavy.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

Yes. I used to do a lot, actually. I'd paint, cook big meals for my family, go for runs before heading to a job site, and I even showed up for community theater rehearsals. But now... I don't know. All of those things just feel like chores. It's like they belong to somebody else's life. I don't even care if I miss them anymore.
Before your husband's injury, had you ever experienced a similar period of depression that lasted at least two weeks?

No, I don't think so. Not like this. Before his injury, things were... fine, mostly. I mean, everyone has bad days, but nothing that lasted for weeks or made me feel this empty. This is the first time it's been like this.
How has your energy been during this period?

It's been really bad. I mean, my job is physical—I install flooring—so I'm used to being tired at the end of the day. But now, it's totally different. By the time I carry just one box of tile into a house, or even just sit down to answer a couple of messages from clients, my body just... it feels like wet cement. And it's not just physical. My head gets so tired, so quickly, that I can't even make simple decisions about the job. I just have no energy for any of it.
How has your sleep been during this period?

My sleep? It's... well, I'm not really sure how to describe it. I haven't really noticed a huge change, to be honest. I mean, I'm exhausted all the time, like I said, but when it comes to actually sleeping at night... I don't know, it's just kind of normal, I guess. I haven't really been paying attention to it.
Have you noticed any significant change in your appetite since this began?

Yeah, actually. Most days, I just... I forget to eat until it's really late in the day. Or if I do try to eat, I take a few bites and my stomach just feels sick. I'm definitely not trying to lose weight, but I've noticed my work pants have gotten pretty loose on me lately.
During this period, have you felt sad, empty, or hopeless nearly every day?
No, not really. I mean, I'm exhausted and I don't want to do anything, but I wouldn't say I feel sad or hopeless. I just feel drained.
During this period, have you felt worthless or excessively guilty nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. Every day. I just... I keep thinking that I'm the reason my husband got worse. And with work, I feel like it's my fault the crew lost jobs, and that clients' homes got messed up. It's like... I don't know, like I've just poisoned everything I touch. I really feel like I deserve whatever happens to me at this point.
